sources.name: Brampton Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, same pattern as Hamilton/Kingston libraries - confirmed live 2026-08-26 with real JSON (e.g. 'Movers and Shakers' toddler program). Also carries the annual 'Newcomer Day' community event when scheduled. Age field distinguishes children's programming from adult.

sources.name: Downtown Brampton BIA
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress/tribe) confirmed live 2026-08-26 - JSON events[] with downtown programming (e.g. 'Seasonal Delights'). Covers Garden Square / Rose Theatre concerts, markets, and festivals in the downtown core.

sources.name: Sheridan College - International Student Events
sources.notes: Sheridan's largest campus (Davis) is in Brampton; page lists Spring/Fall Open Houses and virtual Q&A info sessions for international students specifically, and Sheridan co-signed the City of Brampton's 'International Student Experience Charter'. wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 (not WordPress/The Events Calendar) - no JSON/REST route found on a first pass; dates appear to be static text on the page, worth a manual re-check for hand-entry.

sources.name: Newcomer Centre of Peel (NCP)
sources.notes: Major Brampton-based settlement agency (LINC English classes, employment services, orientation). wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not The Events Calendar plugin; no feed found on a first pass.

sources.name: Peel Newcomer Strategy Group (PNSG)
sources.notes: The Local Immigration Partnership for Mississauga/Brampton/Caledon - runs the annual Newcomer Day (already covered via the Brampton Library Communico feed when it posts there) and other partner programming. wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - not WordPress/The Events Calendar; no feed found on a first pass.

sources.name: City of Brampton Festivals & Events
sources.notes: Custom civic site (not Drupal/WordPress) 2026-08-26, no obvious JSON/REST route found on a first pass. Hosts Summer In The City, Farmers' Market, Mount Pleasant Night Market, Winter Lights Festival, Heritage Sounds. 'Experience Brampton' (experiencebrampton.com) aggregates much of this but its own wp-json/tribe route also 404s - not the plugin used there either.

sources.name: Hope Reformed Church - Free ESL Classes
sources.notes: Standing weekly free ESL classes (Thursdays 7:00-8:30pm at 375 Clark Blvd, Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced, new topic weekly) explicitly for newcomers - contact ESL@hopereformedchurch.ca. wp-json/tribe route 404s 2026-08-26 - no feed, term-based standing program only. Left with an empty manual event list per the no-recurring-events rule.
